_comment: Colab-only full-board pipeline. 'reviewed' must be true before a mapping is used with --strict-labels. Set it only after looking at audit/<source>/<class>_contact.jpg.

good.label: good
good.reason: Explicit class name; confirmed by SolDef paper.

poor_solder.label: insufficient_solder
poor_solder.reason: Plausible but must be checked against contact sheet.

exc_solder.label: other
exc_solder.reason: Excess solder is NOT a bridge. Kept as 'other' to avoid false bridge calls.

no_good.label: other
no_good.reason: docs/datasets.md: component misplacement, NOT a solder bridge.

spike.label: other
spike.reason: Solder spike is NOT automatically a bridge; review contact sheet.

datasets.name: roboflow
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (verify in the logged-in project before use)

COLDSOLDER.label: insufficient_solder
COLDSOLDER.reason: Verify on contact sheet; cold solder != insufficient solder by default.

STICKSOLDER.label: solder_bridge
STICKSOLDER.reason: Only map to bridge after visual confirmation of actual pad-to-pad bridging.
